metadata.description: DeepRead — AI-native document processing API. OCR, structured extraction, PDF form filling, PII redaction, and BYOK. Two engines: Extract (one OCR pass) and Deep Extract (two OCR passes and an LLM judge). Pre-built schemas for invoices, medical records, legal contracts, and insurance claims.

plugins.name: deepread
plugins.description: DeepRead — AI-native document processing API. Extract text and structured data from PDFs and images, fill PDF forms with AI vision, redact 14 types of PII (HIPAA/GDPR ready), and bring your own LLM key on Enterprise. Includes pre-built schemas for invoices, medical records, legal contracts, and insurance claims. Free 2,000 pages/month.
